note: GGK-200/2 P-55-XV, Nera-Bakhapcha series, Neogene-Quaternary map, RASTER (geokniga JPG, CMYK, a digital rendering with flat fills); own legend from the right margin of this scan (2026-11-03), replacing the series legend of P-55-XVII, which lacks lbH2, laIIIjg-kb, a3IIIjg, a4IIIvc and aN2 and numbers the terraces differently; its tints had read dr,sN2-H as e,sH and spread laIIIjg-kb over other units; fills = the legend boxes through the ICC profile, equal to the map face (unit_colours.py); horizon names from the brackets of the legend; aIIIkb, lII-IIIvc, aII and aE-I appear only on the correlation scheme and are omitted
